Assuming each red and green sequence has the same pattern, the uppermost section would be the last to finish for the green sequence. The strips in the waterfront tower light on the right side of the image appear to light up in a specific pattern. This pattern was clearly shown when the red lights were on the display, starting from the bottom upwards.

  Counting from bottom to top, the bottommost strip (1st) lights up, then 2nd -> 3rd -> 6th -> 5th -> 4th -> 7th -> 8th. Hence, the 8th strip is the last to light up, which is on the uppermost part of the light show.
  
 

  Applying the observed sequence for the green lights that were yet to fully light up the waterfront tower's light show before the video frame was shifted, it can be concluded that the uppermost section of the tower's light would be the last to finish.
